title: The Choice
summary: Three years after the Great War, universal temporal entropy begins unraveling the cosmic boundary. Ha-Jun stands before the Gate of the First Origin, facing the ultimate choice of ascension.

panels.shot: the quiet seoul skyline at dusk three years after the war
panels.action: Three years of peace: warm amber lights shimmer along the Han River as modern trains glide across bridges.
panels.prose_en: Three years of peace: warm amber lights shimmer along the Han River as modern trains glide across bridges.
panels.prose_hi: Shanti ke teen sal: haan nadi ke kinare garm amber roshni jhilmilati hai kyonki aadhunik trainen pulon par chalti han.

panels.shot: inside the kang family apartment: ha-jun studying at a wooden desk
panels.action: 20-year-old Ha-Jun Kang, taller and broader with confident mature features, reviews quantum physics notes.
panels.prose_en: 20-year-old Ha-Jun Kang, taller and broader with confident mature features, reviews quantum physics notes.
panels.prose_hi: 20 varshiya ha-jun cong, lambe aur chaude, aatmavishwas se bhare paripakv features ke sath, quantum bhautiki notes ki samiksha karte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun walking into the room holding two mugs of hot tea
panels.action: Tae-Jun, wearing a comfortable olive sweater and spectacles, sets a steaming mug of jasmine tea beside Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Take a break, professor. You've been reading for six hours straight.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun, wearing a comfortable olive sweater and spectacles, sets a steaming mug of jasmine tea beside Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun, ek aaramdayak jaitoon sweater aur chashma pahane hue, ha-jun ke bagal mein chameli chai ka ek bhaap se bhara mag rakhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun taking a sip smiling warmly at his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun leans back in his chair, taking a warm sip: 'Thanks, Tae-Jun. I was just checking the planetary ward frequencies.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ward frequencies perfect hain. No demonic breaches anywhere.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leans back in his chair, taking a warm sip: 'Thanks, Tae-Jun. I was just checking the planetary ward frequencies.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni kursi par peeche jhuk gaya aur ek garm ghunt piya: 'dhanyavad, taaye-jun. main bus grahiy ward aavrittiyon ki janch kar raha tha.'

panels.shot: kuro sleeping on the bookshelf on a soft red velvet cushion
panels.action: Kuro naps lazily on his private cushion beside Ha-Jun's university textbooks, snoring softly.
panels.prose_en: Kuro naps lazily on his private cushion beside Ha-Jun's university textbooks, snoring softly.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ki vishwavidyalaya ki pathyapustakon ke paas apne niji gadde par aaram se sota hai aur dhire-dhire kharate leta hai.

panels.shot: sudden microscopic temporal glitch: ha-jun tea freezing mid-swirl
panels.action: In Ha-Jun's mug, the swirling jasmine tea freezes completely for half a second, then resumes.
panels.prose_en: In Ha-Jun's mug, the swirling jasmine tea freezes completely for half a second, then resumes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke mag men, ghumti hui chameli ki chai aadhe second ke liye puri tarah se jam jaati hai, phir shuru ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: outside the window: a flock of pigeons hanging stationary in the air
panels.action: Through the glass, five flying pigeons hang frozen mid-flap against the twilight sky.
panels.prose_en: Through the glass, five flying pigeons hang frozen mid-flap against the twilight sky.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ke madhyam se, paanch udte hue kabootar godhuli aakash ke madhya flap par jame hue latke hue han.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes narrowing as the sovereign core in his chest pulses
panels.action: The integrated Sovereign Core in Ha-Jun's chest beats with deep celestial resonance.
panels.prose_en: The integrated Sovereign Core in Ha-Jun's chest beats with deep celestial resonance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki chhati mein ekikrit sovereign core gahri akashiya pratidhvani ke saath dhadkata hai.

panels.shot: kuro snapping awake fluttering onto the desk
panels.action: Kuro's ruby eyes glow: 'The universal fabric... It's fraying at the Origin Seam.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Asmodaius's ancient scar is finally giving out. The universe is losing coherence.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's ruby eyes glow: 'The universal fabric... It's fraying at the Origin Seam.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki ruby aankhen chamakti han: 'sarvbhaumik kapada... yah mool seem par toot raha hai.'

panels.shot: a golden dimensional door materializing in the center of the living room
panels.action: A door of pure white marble carved with living starlight appears, bearing the crest of the Cosmic Tree.
panels.mood: the gate of the first origin
panels.prose_en: A door of pure white marble carved with living starlight appears, bearing the crest of the Cosmic Tree.
panels.prose_hi: Jivit taron ki roshni se ukera gaya shuddh safed sangmarmar ka ek darwaja dikhai deta hai, jis par brahmandiya vriksh ka shikhar ankit hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping protectively in front of ha-jun claymore half-drawn
panels.action: Tae-Jun instinctively draws his bronze blade: 'What is this?! Another void gate?!'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun instinctively draws his bronze blade: 'What is this?! Another void gate?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun sahajta se apna kansya blade nikalta hai: 'yah kya hai?! ek aur shunya dwar?!'

panels.shot: ha-jun placing gentle hand on tae-jun wrist lowering the sword
panels.action: Ha-Jun lowers his brother's weapon gently: 'No, Hyung. This is the Origin Gate. It has been calling me for months.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh dushman nahi hai. It's the universe itself.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lowers his brother's weapon gently: 'No, Hyung. This is the Origin Gate. It has been calling me for months.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apne bhai ke hathiyar ko dheere se neeche kar diya: 'nahin, hung. yah udgam dwar hai. yah mujhe kai mahinon se bula raha hai.'

panels.shot: an ethereal female voice echoing from the golden door: the voice of the cosmos
panels.action: A soothing, motherly voice echoes: 'Ha-Jun Kang. True Sovereign of mortal blood. Step forward.'

dialogue.speaker: cosmic_voice
dialogue.text: The scar of the First Demon must now be sealed forever.

panels.prose_en: A soothing, motherly voice echoes: 'Ha-Jun Kang. True Sovereign of mortal blood. Step forward.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek sukhdayak, matr-swar goonjata hai: 'ha-jun cong. nashwar rakt ka sachcha swami. aage kadam.'.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping through the threshold into the garden of creation
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps through: an infinite garden of silver trees whose leaves are galaxies, standing over an ocean of light.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps through: an infinite garden of silver trees whose leaves are galaxies, standing over an ocean of light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aage badhta hai: chandi ke pedon ka ek anant udyan jiski pattiyan aakashagangaen han, prakash ke sagar ke upar khada hai.

panels.shot: in the center of the garden: the towering tree of origin
panels.action: A colossal tree of pure white light whose roots anchor every dimension in the multiverse.
panels.prose_en: A colossal tree of pure white light whose roots anchor every dimension in the multiverse.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh shwet prakash ka ek vishal vriksh jiski jaden vividhata ke har aayam ko jodti han.

panels.shot: a deep black crack running down the trunk of the world tree
panels.action: A jagged black fissure oozes anti-matter sap from the tree's bark—the original wound caused by Asmodaius 5,000 years ago.
panels.prose_en: A jagged black fissure oozes anti-matter sap from the tree's bark—the original wound caused by Asmodaius 5,000 years ago.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dantedar kali daraar se ped ki chhaal se anti-mater ras nikalta hai - 5,000 saal pehle esmodius dwara banaya gaya mool ghav.

panels.shot: the spirit of the tree manifesting as a maiden of starlight
panels.action: A radiant woman composed of nebulae and comets steps from the trunk: 'The universe is dying of this bleed.'

dialogue.speaker: tree_maiden
dialogue.text: Only the complete Sovereign Bloodline can fuse this wound.

panels.prose_en: A radiant woman composed of nebulae and comets steps from the trunk: 'The universe is dying of this bleed.'.
panels.prose_hi: Neeharikaon aur dhumketuon se bani ek deeptimaan mahila trunk se utarti hai: 'brahmand is khoon se mar raha hai.'

panels.shot: the maiden explaining the two choices before ha-jun
panels.action: Maiden: 'Choice one: Reset reality. Earth will have no demons, but you will forget your brother and your friends.'

dialogue.speaker: tree_maiden
dialogue.text: Reset the timeline. All suffering vanishes, but your memories dissolve.

panels.prose_en: Maiden: 'Choice one: Reset reality. Earth will have no demons, but you will forget your brother and your friends.'.
panels.prose_hi: Meden: 'pahla vikalp: vastavikta ko reset karen. prithvi par koi rakshas nahin hoga, lekin tum apne bhai aur apne doston ko bhool jaoge.'

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening in horror at the thought of forgetting tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun shakes his head violently: 'Forget Tae-Jun?! Forget the brother who bled for me for seven years?! NEVER!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main apne bhai ko bhoolne ki keemat par azaadi nahi chahta!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shakes his head violently: 'Forget Tae-Jun?! Forget the brother who bled for me for seven years?! NEVER!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne zor se apna sir hilaya: 'taaye-jun ko bhool jao?! us bhai ko bhool jao jisne saat saal tak mere liye khoon bahaya?! kabhi nahin!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun asking the second choice with resolute steel in his voice
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'What is the second choice?'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'What is the second choice?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'dusri pasand kya hai?'

panels.shot: the maiden looking at ha-jun with solemn respect and awe
panels.action: Maiden: 'Choice two: Transcendence. Ascend beyond the mortal plane and bind your own soul into the Tree's root.'

dialogue.speaker: tree_maiden
dialogue.text: Become the immortal Pillar. You will live forever, but as the eternal anchor of reality.

panels.prose_en: Maiden: 'Choice two: Transcendence. Ascend beyond the mortal plane and bind your own soul into the Tree's root.'.
panels.prose_hi: Yuvti: 'vikalp do: atikraman. nashwar viman se pare chadhen aur apni aatma ko vriksh ki jad mein bandhen.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at his open hands seeing his mortal skin
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his hands: 'Will I still be able to see my brother? Will I still be able to visit Earth?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kya main apne parivaar se mil paunga?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his hands: 'Will I still be able to see my brother? Will I still be able to visit Earth?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne hathon ko dekhta hai: 'kya main ab bhi apne bhai ko dekh paunga? kya main ab bhi prithvi par ja sakunga?'

panels.shot: the maiden smiling with gentle warmth: 'love is not bound by dimension'
panels.action: Maiden: 'A True Sovereign rules all realms. Where your heart rests, there you shall walk.'

dialogue.speaker: tree_maiden
dialogue.text: You will not be a prisoner. You will be the foundation of their safety.

panels.prose_en: Maiden: 'A True Sovereign rules all realms. Where your heart rests, there you shall walk.'.
panels.prose_hi: Meden: 'ek sachcha samprabhu sabhi kshetron par shasan karta hai. jahan aapka dil aaram karega, vahan aap chalenge.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling with radiant, peaceful certainty
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles, the tension evaporating from his shoulders: 'Then the choice is simple. I will become the Pillar.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine apna faisla kar liya hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles, the tension evaporating from his shoulders: 'Then the choice is simple. I will become the Pillar.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun muskurata hai, uske kandhon se tanaav gayab ho jata hai: 'fir chunav saral hai. main stambh banunga.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping back through the golden door into his apartment
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps back into his living room where Tae-Jun and Kuro wait anxiously.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps back into his living room where Tae-Jun and Kuro wait anxiously.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne living room mein wapas chala jata hai jahan taaye-jun aur kuro utsukta se intjaar karte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun rushing over grabbing ha-jun shoulders: 'what happened?!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun inspects him worriedly: 'Ha-Jun! What was behind that door?! Are you alright?!'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun inspects him worriedly: 'Ha-Jun! What was behind that door?! Are you alright?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne chintit hokar uska nirikshan kiya: 'ha-jun! us darvaje ke peeche kya tha?! kya aap theek ho?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling gently resting his hand over tae-jun hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with infinite warmth: 'No threats, Hyung. Just the final step of our journey.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sab theek hai. Call Min-Jae and Captain Baek. We are having our final summit on the rooftop.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with infinite warmth: 'No threats, Hyung. Just the final step of our journey.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aseem garmjoshi ke saath muskurata hai: 'koi khatra nahin, hung. bus hamari yatra ka antim charan.'

panels.shot: kuro tilting his head sensing the divine aura shift around ha-jun
panels.action: Kuro's ruby eyes glow softly: 'You chose transcendence, didn't you, My Sovereign?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You chose to become the eternal shield.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's ruby eyes glow softly: 'You chose transcendence, didn't you, My Sovereign?'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki ruby aankhen dheere se chamakti han: 'aapne utkrishtata ko chuna, hai na, mere prabhu?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding to kuro with quiet pride
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods: 'Because that's what a brother does.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun nods: 'Because that's what a brother does.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sir hilata hai: 'kyonki ek bhai yahi karta hai.'

panels.shot: the brothers walking out the apartment door together cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun step out of apartment 402 into the cool evening air, ready for the final ascension!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun step out of apartment 402 into the cool evening air, ready for the final ascension!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur taaye-jun sham ki thandi hawa mein apartment 402 se bahar nikle, antim aarohan ke liye taiyar!
